title: Envelope
description: EPR envelope — the protocol-owned header of an EPR atom (spec §4.1). Source of truth: EPR atom, self-notarized via content-address (CIDv1 dag-cbor sha256) + Ed25519 signature. Canonical CBOR bytes + detached signature is the authoritative form. Category A — notarized; notarization mechanism is content-derived CID + signer proof (not DHT). JSON wire format: all CID fields (cid, schemaRef, claims items, coupling legs, supersedes, supersededBy) serialize as integer arrays (byte representation of CIDv1 multihash binary form, via cid crate serde-codec feature). Optional fields supersedes and supersededBy are absent (not null) when not set.

cid.description: Self-derived CIDv1 content identifier of the canonical bytes. Serialized as a byte array. NOT included in canonical signing bytes.

schemaRef.description: CIDv1 of the Manifest EPR that declares the payload schema, serialized as a byte array.

schemaKey.description: Content-type key within the referenced manifest.

claims.description: Outcome claims this EPR asserts. Each element is a CIDv1 serialized as a byte array.

supersedes.description: CIDv1 of the prior version if this is a revision, serialized as a byte array. Absent when not set (skip_serializing_if).

supersededBy.description: Forward pointer to the superseding EPR CID, derived from supersedence index. NOT in canonical bytes. Absent when not set (skip_serializing_if).

issuedAt.description: UTC timestamp, RFC3339 with seconds precision and Z suffix (e.g. '2026-04-21T12:00:00Z'). Included in canonical bytes.
